decisions.reason: The firm has invested in roughly 200 agency templates and gives the product its own page, and the positive customer quote supports its agency focus, so management will attribute any slow uptake to a temporary ramp-up and persist.

Featured on the home page, the hosting management platform is the most visible public commitment and central to the firm's announced direction, so dropping it would contradict earlier decisions that management must justify.

The configurable managed hosting plan complements the platform and has its own page; after only one year, management will treat missing results as temporary and keep its sunk investment in the market.
